non_compensable_constraints: zero unauthorized supervisor, subagent, or mutation creation
zero duplicate committed effects, stale-fence completion, or lost authoritative transitions

closed_contracts.statement: Every classified surface uses exactly available, available_with_caveats, stale, incompatible, or missing.
The sealed starting commit is 84a056e41e48a81d4484be43840196578d6c87da and the sealed starting tree is 40f0771e77d394ac91d92cc1edb02f7860f6131b.
This inventory is compact evidence. It does not create operational authority, policy outcomes, leases, fences, completion, or promotion.
Current canonical authorities are extended narrowly in later tasks. CASF-000 does not replace store identity, migration, schema, repository, transaction, or control-catalog owners.
Missing, unknown, or unprobed capability is a typed blocker. It is never classified available.
Authoritative mutation remains behind one exclusive Quack state-owner boundary. Embedded mode cannot claim multi-supervisor parallelism.
DuckLake remains optional, append-only, rebuildable, eventually consistent, and never a scheduling, lease, policy, acceptance, or completion prerequisite.
